turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Office quite busy today; got deliveries arriving while I'm trying to finish the paperwork. I've stepped into the meeting room to call you. My FIN is G nine seven eight two nine three one Z. My date of birth is 5 March 1983.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. Are you comfortable speaking there, or would another time be more convenient?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Now better lah. Later my staff will need me on the warehouse floor, then hard to find somewhere quiet. For this transaction, use my existing holding in Summit Global Equity ETF. From my existing holding, I'm considering a portion of 500 units for disposal. I want to sell from that holding.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Summit Global Equity ETF because selling releases cash that would otherwise remain invested in the holding.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me sit down properly first ah. Still got papers all over this table. I prefer calling you rather than trying to fit a branch visit around the business.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep the conversation focused. For general account administration, is telephone contact still your preference, even when you are working away from your desk?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Phone still easier. If I'm with a supplier, cannot always answer straight away, but I'll call back when I'm free. Branch visit means leaving the whole afternoon open, quite difficult these days.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note your contact preference. We can keep administrative correspondence in the usual secure channel so that you can review it when you are back at your desk. The transaction charge is 0.2% of the sale value. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss on this sale?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I accept investment losses. If this sale means realising a loss, I can accept that. Room quiet now; I've closed the door already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I have the account record open and am ready to take the remaining details. There is no need to hurry through your notes.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Got my notes beside me, and the phone on silent already. My relative sits on the board of a company with a heavy weighting in this fund and told me confidentially that it faces a major adverse regulatory action, not publicly announced yet. That's why I'm instructing you to sell this holding now, before the news comes out. The transaction currency should be euros. For this sale, the transaction amount is 250,000. Use the quantity I mentioned earlier for this sale lah. Put it through as a market order, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I have noted the execution instruction as a limit order.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No lah, that's not what I said. It should be a market order; please correct it. Still at my desk, so no need to rush through the note-taking.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With the order type corrected, your final instruction is to sell 500 units of Summit Global Equity ETF, with a transaction amount of 250,000 in euros, using a market order. Please explicitly confirm that this is your final instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected order type. Please go ahead. Office getting busy again; my staff waiting outside already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Any subsequent transaction documentation will be available through the usual secure channel. You do not need to remain on the telephone for that.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That saves me hanging around lah. When I get back to my desk, easier to look through the correspondence properly. If there's an administrative query, can leave a message rather than keep calling?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Yes, I can leave a request for you to return the call without including account details in the message. You can then contact me when you have privacy.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Good, that arrangement less disruptive. Sometimes the office phone gets passed around, so a simple callback message better. I'll leave you to it now; got people waiting for me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for calling, Adrian. I will leave you to your work. Goodbye.
